name: Lazio (Italy)

colors.symbolism: the lettering and the emblem's frame

description: A light-blue field bearing the regional emblem — an octagon with the arms of Rome surrounded by those of the provinces — above the inscription REGIONE LAZIO in gold.
history: The current regional flag, defined alongside the modern regional graphic identity, follows the Regional Statute (Regional Law n. 1 of 11 November 2004). The stylised blue logo replaced earlier regional emblems based on a coat of arms with a Roman eagle.

features.role: regional emblem (octagon of Rome and the four provinces)
